entry.title: What Happens When Everyone Can Build Software

media:group.media:title: What Happens When Everyone Can Build Software
media:group.media:description:
In this episode of the Lightcone, the hosts sit down with Paul Copplestone, co-founder and CEO of Supabase. Since starting in the YC summer batch of 2020, the company has exploded to 13 million users and over 50 million databases under management. Supabase is now positioning for a future where everyone can write their own software, billions have access to personal databases and agents are driving much of the demand.

media:group.media:title: AI for the Air-Gapped Economy
media:group.media:description:
Some of the most valuable data in the world can never leave the building. Defense contractors, banks, hospitals, and nuclear plants can’t simply send it to a cloud AI API.
That creates an opportunity to bring frontier AI inside those walls: on-prem models, deployment tooling, security accreditation, and hardware for the parts of the economy the cloud can’t reach.
Apply for the Winter 2027 batch at ycombinator.com/apply.
